run_prepare_input_data: run the script to prepare pickle and JSON input files for fashion generator and classifier networks
run_get_composing_pieces_in_outfit: run get_composing_pieces_in_outfit to extract unique segmentation labels from a mask image file
run_get_bbox: run get_bbox to get the bounding box coordinates from an image file path
run_option_parser: run option_parser to parse command line arguments for img_dir, mask_dir, and output file paths
review_prepare_input_data: review the script that processes fashion images and masks into pickle and JSON files for neural networks
